message: This is for Cathy, to finish answering your question. (COMAR) is the code of Maryland regulations. It is the regulations for every agency in the state. It guides them in the manner in which things are handle. This is the page for the PSC(public service commission)in handling utility disputes. www.dsd.state.md.us/comar/20/20.32.01.04.htm  Also if you want to see what a RFP (request for proposal ) looks like, in your search engine type in RFP NO 329.01-143 and it will bring up the RFP for the state of Tennessee. Don't be discouraged, there will be a lot you will not be able to understand but there you will see some things that you do understand.
